current_activity: Reinhard's LXXXVIII Corps holds the British XII Corps near Best and attacks Veghel from the west
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 8 p. 191-192: "General Reinhard's LXXXVIII Corps tried to co-operate with a complementary thrust from the west" and "west of the corridor his troops had held the 12 British Corps in the vicinity of Best". Event definition: the attack of 23 September (D plus 6). Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Best, Noord-Brabant, with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: a sector point; the corps headquarters is not placed. Location support: CMH names the vicinity of Best. Commander: General Reinhard. Opponents: British XII Corps, US 101st Airborne Division.
